_comment: This tool's references, in citation order: the tool's pages number them [1], [2], ... in this order (IEEE style). Each needs an archived copy: give 'fetch' (one URL or a list to try) and the Archive sources workflow saves it as sources/<file>; set 'render': true for web pages. Title style: 'quoted' for articles, web pages and parts of books; 'italic' for books, reports and datasets.
